text.description_html:
Rubber Tips for Deltana BDH Baseboard Door Bumpers

This is a replacement gray rubber tip for the Deltana Baseboard Door Bumpers.

For use with: Deltana BDH35 Baseboard Door Stops

Specifications: for Deltana BDH35-REPL-TIP Rubber Tip Replacement

  • Total Height: 1/2"
  • Diameter: 25/32"
  • Rubber Color: Gray

Warning: These work for BDH series Baseboard Door Stops manufactured by Deltana. If you are not sure if your door stop was manufactured by Deltana, do NOT order these as they may not work properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
